mentions.name: CraftMyGame
mentions.description: A no-code game engine and visual editor that grows a library of reusable building blocks — multiplayer, event systems, NPC behaviors, pathfinding, and mobile controls — extracted from games the author ships. It includes an asset marketplace where artists upload tilesets and characters that drop directly into the editor with in-game previews, and an LLM builder (coding agent) that assembles a game from a text description by pulling marketplace assets and wiring up existing building blocks, producing a game users can then tweak in the manual editor.
mentions.problem: Even with a no-code editor, users don't know where to start; the AI builder assembles a starting game from existing building blocks so users have a game ready to work on.
mentions.source_excerpt: I love making games, and I've been building a no-code game engine by extracting reusable components every time I ship a new game. It started as me scratching my own itch, and now it's turning into a real platform.

evidence.value: I love making games, and I've been building a no-code game engine by extracting reusable components every time I ship a new game. It started as me scratching my own itch, and now it's turning into a real platform.

mentions.name: CraftMyGame
mentions.description: No-code 2D game engine and visual editor that grows a library of reusable building blocks (multiplayer, event systems, NPC behaviors, pathfinding) extracted from each game the author ships. Includes a node-graph visual event system for game logic (trigger, conditions, chained actions, similar to Unreal Blueprints but focused on 2D) and a marketplace where pixel artists upload tilesets and characters that are usable directly inside the engine without ZIP downloads or import setup. Games can also be exported to Godot 4 with terrain, animations, and hitboxes, so nothing is locked in.
mentions.problem: Most people who want to make games need assets and don't know how to get or make them.

mentions.name: CraftMyGame
mentions.description: A no-code multiplayer game editor and engine that lets anyone build multiplayer games in a few clicks without writing code and share them instantly. The platform ships the tedious parts out of the box—multiplayer networking, controls, mobile/responsive layouts, inventories, save/load, leaderboards, quests, and dialogue—while users just select and configure features via clicks. The engine reads a config file and renders the game for players, with templates provided as starting points.
mentions.problem: The features necessary for a multiplayer game (multiplayer, controls, inventories, save/load, leaderboards, quests, dialogue, etc.) are annoying to set up manually, so the platform handles them out of the box without code.
mentions.audience: Anyone who wants to make games without code; game designers are being onboarded to stress-test the editor and engine.
mentions.source_excerpt:

mentions.name: CraftMyGame
mentions.description: A no-code multiplayer game editor that lets anyone create multiplayer games in a few clicks without writing code and share them instantly. Users pick a template (platformer, tower defense, battle arena, etc.), customize it through a UI, and get real-time multiplayer with up to a large number of players—no networking code, everything hosted. Built-in game systems include AI behaviors, combat, inventories, save/load, and live leaderboards. The engine reads a config file and renders it for players, with LLM-based generation planned after the foundation is solid.
mentions.problem: Creating multiplayer games normally requires writing code and handling networking and hosting.
